_note: Dr. Light Numbers for this lab. Canon uses DLN-000 to DLN-08x; ours start at DLN-100.

robots.name: Rush
robots.job: Heartbeat: reads the pj_agent inbox and watched board tasks, drafts replies into an approval queue, flags escalations for Auto (Claude Code).

robots.name: Guts Man
robots.job: Builds dbt models in analytics/ over the lab's own eval data. In training: earns the dbt-model weapon by matching reference models on the dbt-model stage.

robots.name: Roll
robots.job: Housekeeper. Drafts commit messages (later PR bodies) from a diff for Auto or PJ to approve, and triages stale branches `lab git tidy` leaves for review. Looks after Dependabot PRs in PJ's other repos: answers whether each is safe to merge while Claude decides and merges (`lab roll chores`). Sorts PJ's mail archive into keep and discard classes so deletion is "old and not kept" (docs/plans/roll-keep.md); labels only, PJ deletes. In training: commit-message and dependabot-merge stages. Weapon: mail-keep.
